about: Lines of an item's context, read by the guard's CHALLENGED_LINE (hooks/question_form.py) and by the waiting page's card. draws: case means the line is drawn as the case block, context means it stays in the context. A line draws as a case when the guard's pattern matches it and its text after the colon is not empty. Copied from the guard's own test shapes (hooks/test_question_form.py, tests/guard/s42850-question-challenged.py), so both readers test the same lines.
